subject: Human Body
title: Good Bacteria vs Bad Bacteria
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Good Bacteria vs Bad Bacteria.

hook.text: Not all gut bacteria help. Some cause disease. The balance between them determines your gut health.

buildup.text: Beneficial species like Lactobacillus produce acids that keep harmful bacteria from taking over.

discovery.text: Dysbiosis occurs when harmful bacteria outnumber good ones. It's linked to IBS, obesity, and even depression.

twist.text: Antibiotics kill both good and bad bacteria. One course can reduce microbiome diversity for months.

climax.text: Gut health depends on bacterial balance. A diverse microbiome resists invaders better than a depleted one.

punchline.text: Diversity in your gut means resilience for your body.

quiz.question: What is dysbiosis?
options: An excess of fiber in the diet
An imbalance where harmful bacteria outnumber beneficial ones
A condition where the colon produces too much mucus
